name: 2025 World Championships Deck: Flutter Devo Gardevoir

releases.name: 2025 World Championships Deck: Flutter Devo Gardevoir

description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2025 World Championships, at what many expected to be Gardevoir ex's last World Championships before it left the Standard format. Gardevoir ex's Psychic Embrace piles on Energy and damage counters, Munkidori moves the counters onto the opponent's Pokémon and Scream Tail can hit the Bench; in the final, against a Dragon-type deck, Lillie's Clefairy ex gave the opponent's Dragon-type Pokémon a Psychic Weakness. The 2025 World Championships were held from 15 to 17 August 2025 at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California, which had also hosted them in 2017.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2025 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
